25798-boy-scouts-in-the-north-sea-or-the.title: "The Mystery of a Sub"
25798-boy-scouts-in-the-north-sea-or-the.creator: G. Harvey Ralphson
25798-boy-scouts-in-the-north-sea-or-the.description: A book by G. Harvey Ralphson. "We surely are!" assured the one addressed as Jimmie. "I'll bet I can tell you what that is! The Belgians cut their dikes and flooded the country to drive out the Germans. My dream book says that's it!"

arxiv-2012-07591.title: A moving boundary approach of capturing diffusants penetration into rubber: FEM approximation and comparison with laboratory measurements
arxiv-2012-07591.creator: S. Nepal, R. Meyer, N. H. Kröger, T. Aiki, A. Muntean, Y. Wondmagegne, U. Giese
arxiv-2012-07591.description: Abstract We propose a moving-boundary scenario to model the penetration of diffusants into dense and foamed rubbers. The presented modelling approach recovers experimental findings related to the diffusion of cyclohexane and the resulting swelling in a piece of material made of ethylene propylene diene monomer rubber (EPDM).

arxiv-2104-05694.title: On the Inductive Bias of Masked Language Modeling: From Statistical to Syntactic Dependencies
arxiv-2104-05694.creator: Tianyi Zhang, Tatsunori B. Hashimoto
arxiv-2104-05694.description: Abstract We study how masking and predicting tokens in an unsupervised fashion can give rise to linguistic structures and downstream performance gains. Recent theories have suggested that pretrained language models acquire useful inductive biases through masks that implicitly act as cloze reductions.

arxiv-2106-04981.title: Raman spectroscopic evidence for multiferroicity in rare earth nickelate single crystals
arxiv-2106-04981.creator: I. Ardizzone, J. Teyssier, I. Crassee, A. B. Kuzmenko, D. G. Mazzone, D. J. Gawryluk, M. Medarde, D. van der Marel
arxiv-2106-04981.description: Abstract The rare earth nickelates RNiO 3 are metallic at high temperatures and insulating and magnetically ordered at low temperatures. The low temperature phase has been predicted to be type II multiferroic, i.e. ferroelectric and magnetic order are coupled and occur simultaneously. Confirmation of those ideas has been inhibited by the absence of experimental data on single crystals.

arxiv-2106-06617.title: Inexact Loops in Robotics Problems
arxiv-2106-06617.creator: Erik Nelson
arxiv-2106-06617.description: Abstract Loops are pervasive in robotics problems, appearing in mapping and localization, where one is interested in finding loop closure constraints to better approximate robot poses or other estimated quantities, as well as planning and prediction, where one is interested in the homotopy classes of the space through which a robot is moving.

arxiv-2107-09033.title: Particle production by a relativistic semitransparent mirror of finite size and thickness
arxiv-2107-09033.creator: Kuan-Nan Lin, Pisin Chen
arxiv-2107-09033.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kuan-Nan Lin, Pisin Chen. Production of massless scalar particles by a relativistic semitransparent mirror of finite transverse size and longitudinal thickness in (1+3)D flat spacetime is studied. The derived particle spectrum formula is applied to two specific trajectories. One is the gravitational collapse trajectory invoked in (1+1)D perfectly reflecting moving mirror literature to mimic Hawking radiation, and the other is the plasma mirror trajectory proposed to be realizable in future experiments.

arxiv-2207-05966.title: Semi-classical gravity phenomenology under the causal-conditional quantum measurement prescription
arxiv-2207-05966.creator: Yubao Liu, Haixing Miao, Yanbei Chen, Yiqiu Ma
arxiv-2207-05966.description: Abstract The semi-classical gravity sourced by the quantum expectation value of the matter’s energy-momentum tensor will change the evolution of the quantum state of matter. This effect can be described by the Schroedinger-Newton (SN) equation, where the semi-classical gravity contributes a gravitational potential term depending on the matter quantum state.

arxiv-2212-12520.title: Observation of suppressed viscosity in the normal state of 3 He due to superfluid fluctuations
arxiv-2212-12520.creator: Rakin N. Baten 1, Yefan Tian 1, Eric N. Smith 1, Erich J. Mueller 1, Jeevak M. Parpia 1∗
arxiv-2212-12520.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Rakin N. Baten 1, Yefan Tian 1, Eric N. Smith 1, Erich J. Mueller 1, Jeevak M. Parpia 1∗. Abstract: By monitoring the quality factor of a quartz tuning fork oscillator we have observed a fluctuation-driven reduction in the viscosity of bulk 3 He in the normal state near the superfluid transition temperature, T c T_{c} .

arxiv-2305-06937.title: Distance sets bounds for polyhedral norms via effective dimension Thanks: B. Wilson was supported by NSF grant, DMS 1856124, and NSF CAREER Fellowship, DMS 2142064.
arxiv-2305-06937.creator: Iqra Altaf, Ryan Bushling, Bobby Wilson
arxiv-2305-06937.description: Abstract . We prove that, for every norm on ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} and every E ⊆ ℝ d E\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{d} , the Hausdorff dimension of the distance set of E E with respect to that norm is at least dim H E − ( d − 1 ) \hdim E-(d-1) .

arxiv-2310-00995.title: FMplex: A Novel Method for Solving Linear Real Arithmetic Problems
arxiv-2310-00995.creator: Jasper Nalbach, Valentin Promies, Erika Ábrahám, Paul Kobialka
arxiv-2310-00995.description: Abstract In this paper we introduce a novel quantifier elimination method for conjunctions of linear real arithmetic constraints. Our algorithm is based on the Fourier-Motzkin variable elimination procedure, but by case splitting we are able to reduce the worst-case complexity from doubly to singly exponential.

arxiv-2310-16523.title: Improving Diversity of Demographic Representation in Large Language Models via Collective-Critiques and Self-Voting
arxiv-2310-16523.creator: Preethi Lahoti Nicholas Blumm Xiao Ma Raghavendra Kotikalapudi, Sahitya Potluri Qijun Tan Hansa Srinivasan Ben Packer, Ahmad Beirami Alex Beutel Jilin Chen
arxiv-2310-16523.description: Abstract A crucial challenge for generative large language models (LLMs) is diversity: when a user’s prompt is under-specified, models may follow implicit assumptions while generating a response, which may result in homogenization of the responses, as well as certain demographic groups being under-represented or even erased from the generated responses.

arxiv-2312-10181.title: Integrating Fairness and Model Pruning Through Bi-level Optimization
arxiv-2312-10181.creator: Yucong Dai, Gen Li, Feng Luo, Xiaolong Ma, Yongkai WuClemson University {yucongd,gen,luofeng,xiaolom,yongkaw}@clemson.edu
arxiv-2312-10181.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yucong Dai, Gen Li, Feng Luo, Xiaolong Ma, Yongkai WuClemson University {yucongd,gen,luofeng,xiaolom,yongkaw}@clemson.edu. Deep neural networks have achieved exceptional results across a range of applications. As the demand for efficient and sparse deep learning models escalates, the significance of model compression, particularly pruning, is increasingly recognized. Traditional pruning methods, however, can unintentionally intensify algorithmic biases, leading to unequal prediction outcomes in critical applications and raising concerns about the dilemma of pruning practices and social justice.

arxiv-2405-20952.title: Continuous momentum state lasing and cavity frequency-pinning with laser-cooled strontium atoms
arxiv-2405-20952.creator: Vera M. Schäfer, Zhijing Niu, Julia R.K. Cline, Dylan J. Young, Eric Yilun Song, Helmut Ritsch, James K. Thompson
arxiv-2405-20952.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Vera M. Schäfer, Zhijing Niu, Julia R.K. Cline, Dylan J. Young, Eric Yilun Song, Helmut Ritsch, James K. Thompson. Laser-cooled gases of atoms interacting with the field of an optical cavity are a powerful tool for quantum sensing and the simulation of open and closed quantum systems.

arxiv-2409-14502.title: Hypergeometric Moments and Hecke Trace Formulas
arxiv-2409-14502.creator: Brian Grove
arxiv-2409-14502.description: Abstract . Moments for hypergeometric functions over finite fields were studied in the work of Ono, Pujahari, Saad, and Saikia for several F 1 2 {}_{2}F_{1} and F 2 3 {}_{3}F_{2} cases. We generalize their work to prove results for new cases where the hypergeometric data is defined over ℚ \mathbb{Q} and primitive.

arxiv-2412-16368.title: Enumeration of interval-closed sets via Motzkin paths and quarter-plane walks
arxiv-2412-16368.creator: Sergi Elizalde, Nadia Lafrenière, Joel Brewster Lewis, Erin McNicholas, Jessica Striker, Amanda Welch
arxiv-2412-16368.description: Abstract We find a generating function for interval-closed sets of the product of two chains poset by constructing a bijection to certain bicolored Motzkin paths. We also find a functional equation for the generating function of interval-closed sets of truncated rectangle posets, including the type A A root poset, by constructing a bijection to certain quarter-plane walks.

arxiv-2502-02716.title: A Unified Understanding and Evaluation of Steering Methods
arxiv-2502-02716.creator: Shawn Im, Sharon Li
arxiv-2502-02716.description: Abstract Latent space steering methods provide a practical approach to controlling large language models by applying steering vectors to intermediate activations, guiding outputs toward desired behaviors while avoiding retraining. Despite their growing importance, the field lacks a unified understanding and consistent evaluation across tasks and datasets, hindering progress.

arxiv-2508-15365.title: Implementation of Milstein Schemes for Stochastic Delay-Differential Equations with Arbitrary Fixed Delays
arxiv-2508-15365.creator: Mitchell Griggs, Kevin Burrage, Pamela Burrage
arxiv-2508-15365.description: Abstract This paper develops methods for numerically solving stochastic delay-differential equations (SDDEs) with multiple fixed delays that do not align with a uniform time mesh. We focus on numerical schemes of strong convergence orders 1 / 2 1/2 and 1 1 , such as the Euler–Maruyama and Milstein schemes, respectively.

arxiv-2510-19025.title: FlexiDataGen: An Adaptive LLM Framework for Dynamic Semantic Dataset Generation in Sensitive Domains
arxiv-2510-19025.creator: Hamed Jelodar, Samita Bai, Roozbeh Razavi-Far, Ali A. Ghorbani
arxiv-2510-19025.description: Abstract Dataset availability and quality remain critical challenges in machine learning, especially in domains where data are scarce, expensive to acquire, or constrained by privacy regulations. Fields such as healthcare, biomedical research, and cybersecurity frequently encounter high data acquisition costs, limited access to annotated data, and the rarity or sensitivity of key events.

arxiv-2511-20338.title: Maintaining Bipartite Colourings on Temporal Graphs on a Budget
arxiv-2511-20338.creator: Duncan Adamson, George B. Mertzios, Paul G. Spirakis
arxiv-2511-20338.description: Abstract Graph colouring is a fundamental problem for networks, serving as a tool for avoiding conflicts via symmetry breaking, for example, avoiding multiple computer processes simultaneously updating the same resource. This paper considers a generalisation of this problem to temporal graphs , i.e., to graphs whose structure changes according to an ordered sequence of edge sets.

arxiv-2601-14078.title: From Trees to Tree-Like: Distribution and Synthesis for Asynchronous Automata
arxiv-2601-14078.creator: Mathieu Lehaut, Anca Muscholl †, Nir Piterman
arxiv-2601-14078.description: Abstract We revisit constructions for distribution and synthesis of Zielonka’s asynchronous automata in restricted settings. We show first a simple, quadratic, distribution construction for asynchronous automata, where the process architecture is tree-like. An architecture is tree-like if there is an underlying spanning tree of the architecture and communications are local on the tree.

arxiv-2602-19621.creator: Jeehoon Park, Junyeong Park
arxiv-2602-19621.description:
A 2026 arXiv research paper by Jeehoon Park, Junyeong Park. We give a systematic treatment of the arithmetic BF theory, introduced by Carlson and Kim. We observe that the Cassels-Tate pairing can be naturally interpreted as an arithmetic BF functional. 0

europmc-pmc6386828.creator: Mariani E, Lisignoli G, Borzì RM, Pulsatelli L.
europmc-pmc6386828.description: The perspectives of regenerative medicine are still severely hampered by the host response to biomaterial implantation, despite the robustness of technologies that hold the promise to recover the functionality of damaged organs and tissues. In this scenario, the cellular and...

plos-pone-0347858.title: Optimizing LSTM networks and feature selection algorithms using GEE data
plos-pone-0347858.creator: Mohammad Kazemi, Reza Naderi Samani, Narges Kariminejad
plos-pone-0347858.description: Optimizing LSTM networks and feature selection algorithms using GEE data

pmc-10594706.title: The role of alternative pre-mRNA splicing in cancer progression
pmc-10594706.creator: Sunkyung Choi, Namjoon Cho, Eun-Mi Kim, Kee K. Kim
pmc-10594706.description: Alternative pre-mRNA splicing is a critical mechanism that generates multiple mRNA from a single gene, thereby increasing the diversity of the proteome. Recent research has highlighted the significance of specific splicing isoforms in cellular processes, particularly in regulating cell numbers.

pmc-10612514.title: Intralesional Axitinib Injection Mitigates Hypertrophic Scar by Inhibiting Angiogenesis Pathway: A Preliminary Study in a Rabbit Ear Model
pmc-10612514.creator: Chuanbo Liu, Liang Tang, Chunsheng Hou, Jufang Zhang, Jinsheng Li
pmc-10612514.description: ObjectiveHigh levels of VEGF and excessive angiogenesis contribute significantly to hypertrophic scar (HS) formation. Our study aimed to preliminarily investigate the effect of axitinib, a selective VEGF receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor, on angiogenesis of HS and to explore its possible mechanism in a rabbit ear model.

pmc-10631720.title: Covalent organic frameworks bearing Ni active sites for free radical-mediated photoelectrochemical organic transformations
pmc-10631720.creator: Cheng Lin, Zhen Shan, Chaoran Dong, Yuan Lu, Weikun Meng, Gen Zhang, Bo Cai, Guanyong Su, Jong Hyeok Park, Kan Zhang
pmc-10631720.description: Photoelectrochemical (PEC) organic transformations occurring at anodes are a promising strategy for circumventing the sluggish kinetics of the oxygen evolution reaction. Here, we report a free radical-mediated reaction instead of direct hole transfer occurring at the solid/liquid interface for PEC oxidation of benzyl alcohol (BA) to benzaldehyde (BAD) with high selectivity.

pmc-10646991.title: The case of a 60‐year‐old man with decline in job performance and changes in personality and judgment
pmc-10646991.creator: Allison Lapins, Borna Bonakdarpour
pmc-10646991.description: nversation with a rigid thought process. Twice in the last year he fell for scams, sharing personal bank account information. There was also a decline in empathy toward his wife. Otherwise, he remains functionally independent with limited insight into any changes. He scored within the normal range on a cognitive screening tool in the office.

pmc-10742853.title: Application of OpenArray Technology to Assess Changes in the Expression of Functionally Significant Genes in the Substantia Nigra of Mice in a Model of Parkinson’s Disease
pmc-10742853.creator: Dmitry Troshev, Anna Kolacheva, Ekaterina Pavlova, Victor Blokhin, Michael Ugrumov
pmc-10742853.description: Studying the molecular mechanisms of the pathogenesis of Parkinson’s disease (PD) is critical to improve PD treatment. We used OpenArray technology to assess gene expression in the substantia nigra (SN) cells of mice in a 1-methyl-4-phenyl-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyridine (MPTP) model of PD and in controls.

pmc-11513085.title: A modified transactional model of stress and coping on depressive symptoms among informal caregivers of persons with dementia
pmc-11513085.creator: Qi Yuan, Tee Hng Tan, Peizhi Wang, Daniel Poremski, Edimansyah Abdin, Harish Magadi, Richard Goveas, Li Ling Ng, Mythily Subramaniam
pmc-11513085.description: Informal caregivers are crucial to the care of persons with dementia (PWD), but their role is often reported as challenging. This study aims to examine caregiver stress and depressive symptoms among informal caregivers of PWD using a modified transactional stress and coping model.

pmc-11658126.title: Exploring autism spectrum disorder and co-occurring trait associations to elucidate multivariate genetic mechanisms and insights
pmc-11658126.creator: Karoliina Salenius, Niina Väljä, Sini Thusberg, Francois Iris, Christine Ladd-Acosta, Christophe Roos, Matti Nykter, Alessio Fasano, Reija Autio, Jake Lin, the GEMMA study
pmc-11658126.description: BackgroundAutism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a partially heritable neurodevelopmental trait, and people with ASD may also have other co-occurring trait such as ADHD, anxiety disorders, depression, mental health issues, learning difficulty, physical health traits and communication challenges. The concomitant development of ASD and other neurological traits is assumed to result from a complex interplay between genetics and the environment.

pmc-11712602.title: Hypothalamic involvement and biomarker candidacy in Alzheimer’s disease in Down syndrome
pmc-11712602.creator: Stephanie S G Brown, Shahid Zaman, John T O'Brien
pmc-11712602.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundPoor sleep is emerging as an important and modifiable risk factor in the development of dementia. The hypothalamus is the only neuroanatomical site of orexin‐producing neurones in the brain and modulates sleep and wakefulness behaviour.

pmc-12407246.title: The National Dementia Workforce Study: Development of Questionnaires for Home Care, Assisted Living, and Nursing Home Settings
pmc-12407246.creator: Joanne Spetz, Laura M. Wagner, Elizabeth M. White, Susan A. Chapman, Winston Chiong, Esther M. Friedman, Lauren B. Gerlach, Krista L. Harrison, Lauren J. Hunt, Soo‐Jeong Lee, Ulrike Muench, Katherine Possin, Alissa Sideman, Johanna van Tyen Silbersack Hickey, Pongpat Putthinun, Jarmin Yeh, Sofia San
pmc-12407246.description: The growing aging population and rising prevalence of dementia are driving increased demand for long‐term care services and supports in the United States. People with dementia require substantial support and care, often from direct care workers in private homes, assisted living communities, and nursing homes.

pmc-12456172.title: Outcomes 10 Years After Implementing an Emergency Department Opt-out Bloodborne Virus Screening Program
pmc-12456172.creator: Liam Townsend, Fiona Herraghty, Seán Brennan, Conor Grant, Wenzhou Wang, Anne Moriarty, Yvonne Lynagh, Lorraine Clancy, Antoinette Power, Brendan Crowley, Suzanne Norris, Darragh Shields, Colm Bergin
pmc-12456172.description: BackgroundBloodborne viruses (BBV) such as hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis C (HCV), and HIV pose significant personal and public health risks. Screening and linkage to treating services are important tools in treatment and preventing onward transmission. This study reports outcomes of 10 years of an opt-out BBV screening program in a large urban emergency department (ED).

pmc-12607231.title: Risk factors for avascular necrosis in pediatric femoral neck fractures: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12607231.creator: Bin Dong, Feihu Li, Chenjing Li
pmc-12607231.description: BackgroundAvascular necrosis (AVN) is a severe complication following pediatric femoral neck fractures (PFNFs). Identifying risk factors for AVN is critical for guiding timely treatment and follow-up. However, prior studies report inconsistent associations. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to identify risk factors associated with AVN after PFNFs.

pmc-13473583.title: Deficiency of G9a boosts muscle regeneration through IL13/Musclin-mediated crosstalk between macrophage and myofiber
pmc-13473583.creator: Ying Jin, Kaiyang Zhou, Siyu Hao, Hu Yue, Haoyu Wang, Zhiyuan Liu, Yihao Zhou, Yunhao Xie, Xinran Liu, Hong Chen, Yuxia Liu, Anlin Peng, Yangkai Li, Kun Huang, Ling Zheng

pmc-13633246.title: Oxygen-dependent subcellular redistribution of PHD3 links the hypoxic microenvironment to mitochondrial metabolic reprogramming in ccRCC
pmc-13633246.creator: Jaelim Sim, Soyeon Lim, Changjun Lee, Hani Jieun Kim, Wonseok Lee, Hyeonki Kim, Hojun Lee, Kimyeong Kim, Mahesh Kumar Teli, Kyeong Beom Jo, Jacob Wright, Jee Soo Park, Myung Eun Lee, Minsun Jung, Minsoo Noh, Dae-Kyum Kim, Mi-Hyun Kim, Dong Wook Choi, Tae Su Choi, Won Sik Ham, Hunsang Lee, Haejin Yoo
pmc-13633246.description: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) is characterized by profound metabolic dysregulation, with both prolyl hydroxylase domain protein 3 (PHD3) and pyruvate carboxylase (PC) independently implicated in disease progression. Although each influences patient outcomes, a direct mechanistic interplay between these two regulators has remained elusive.

uslaw-cfr-t25-s39-215.title: 25 C.F.R. § 39.215 — Can a school receive funding for any part-time students?
uslaw-cfr-t25-s39-215.creator: Bureau Of Indian Affairs, Department Of The Interior

(b) The school must count.
